name: Melee Archer (Ex)
body:
Benefit: A rogue with this talent may flank enemies 10 feet away from her while using a ranged weapon, as if the ranged weapon were a reach weapon. If the rogue threatens squares with her ranged weapons (i.e., through the Snap Shot feat,) she may also flank enemies inside her threatened area.

Normal: Ranged weapons cannot be used to flank.
